others.route: Visa de residencia temporal de deportista, artista o gestor cultural

note: Ecuador: a foreigner coming to carry out artistic activities takes the temporary residence visa for athletes, artists and cultural managers, applied for online on the Foreign Ministry's e-VISAS platform (gob.ec, updated 20 January 2026). Whether a visitor may be paid for a performance wasn't found; no days are modelled. Read through a fetch that serves the page to this client in excerpts, since gob.ec didn't answer it directly.

sources.title: Gob.ec (Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores y Movilidad Humana), Concesión de visa de residencia temporal de deportista, artista o gestor cultural (actualizado 2026/01/20)
sources.said: Autorización de residencia temporal que otorga el Estado ecuatoriano a las personas extranjeras que tienen la intención ... para realizar actividades deportivas, artísticas o culturales.
